defects.existing_coverage: Gameplay commits have a PostgreSQL owner fence; effect claims and non-idempotent unknown-outcome rules are mentioned.
defects.design_gap: Claim/dispatch/publication authority is not specified tightly enough to distinguish a durable job surviving disconnect from a stale session process continuing new external work after losing its fence.
defects.failure_scenario: Owner A is partitioned after committing an intent; owner B recovers it. Both dispatch paid jobs, or A sends a stale private view before noticing ownership transfer. A provider call may continue even when its result cannot commit.
defects.required_repair: Define effect claim generation/owner token, persisted dispatch-intent/request identity and reservation before call; validate at controlled dispatch boundaries, generation-fence publication, revoke old publication leases, and transfer only undelivered work safely. Document irreducible dispatch/ack uncertainty: losing a claim never proves no supplier call and cannot trigger automatic non-idempotent repeat. Recovery process generation, distributed lease clock authority, permitted timer catch-up and fail-closed DB-loss behavior belong to the same protocol.

Provider with idempotency reuses stable key; provider without it leaves ambiguous dispatch unknown for reconciliation, not auto-repeat. Charged orphaned call is accounted for.
Owner lease expiry/clock skew/run reset/DB outage rejects stale admissions and timer results while committed work remains discoverable.
defects.external_evidence_gate: Actual Pg transaction/isolation/clock and provider adapter behavior require executable fault injection after implementation; no exactly-once external-call guarantee.

defects.failure_scenario: Groups enjoy one free cinematic demo but fail to schedule repeat sessions; CAC exceeds contribution lifetime. A small number of private-voice/high-context users consume the plan allowance or flood support. High MRR still produces operating loss.

Each channel/cohort reports invited/activated/paying/renewed groups and spend denominators, support tickets/minutes, COGS tail and voluntary return; uncertainty remains explicit with too few samples.
Growth scenario reports required active paying campaigns and replacement demand under selected churn, then CAC/payback and burn sensitivity; reject infeasible offer instead of declaring profitable.

Published supported-subset versus full-support labels and trademark/attribution are reviewed against actual selected manifest.

Lose owner/asset/collector host independently; resulting availability/loss matches declared envelope, no fictional HA or complete logs.
Rolling compatible upgrade and rejected incompatible rollback preserve active sessions; alerts and operator recovery paths exercised, measured restored time/data loss recorded.

Immutable record text and required exact replay cannot both remain unconditional promises after erasure.
defects.failure_scenario: Account deletion removes an index but source episodes or a restore rebuild it; private material remains in agent exports/pinned evidence. Replay silently reconstructs removed identity details or treats redacted history as intact.

Separate minimum nonpersonal source/action provenance from deletable payloads; redacted replay reports scoped gap and never regenerates deleted text. Define shared-campaign contributor conflicts and lawful retained source denominator without promising universal immediate erasure.
observable_acceptance: Delete consented private episode/voice/backstory; authorized queries, summaries, rebuilt indexes and cache outputs cannot redisclose it after restart/restore.
Pinned evidence/exports and provider copies have explicit retention/access treatment; operation reports fulfilled/retained/unsupported portions with safe reasons.
Replay of redacted range shows declared gap while durable source-required progression/ledger invariants remain correct; never paid regenerate deleted content.

defects.title: Browser tunnel resource bounds and explicit feasibility stop
defects.existing_coverage: Real WASM all-four-mode feasibility, safe executor, HTTP/2 flow control, finite queue/message limits and concurrent traffic are already mandatory.
defects.design_gap: WebSocket receive buffering is outside the application queue; the gate lacks exact mechanism/measurement limiting messages/in-flight window before callbacks and an explicit failure decision path. A normal Tonic client cannot be assumed browser-compatible.
defects.failure_scenario: Suspended/slow browser accumulates native WebSocket buffers even though Rust channel is bounded; a large data message is allocated before rejection. Bulk asset/tunnel traffic increases action tail latency; unsafe Send patch conceals runtime mismatch.
defects.required_repair: Add tunnel/HTTP2 negotiated maximum frame/header/message and credit/window/in-flight accounting, low-priority bulk scheduling, receive/native-buffer observation and malicious peer termination. Specify bound across browser WebSocket delivery, Rust adapter, HTTP2 driver and gRPC messages, half-close/trailers/cancel states. All required four modes/Rust-only source stay; G02 PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE with exact device/build and owner redesign decision blocks dependent work if infeasible, no silent grpc-web/envelope substitute.
observable_acceptance: Actual single-threaded WASM in selected browsers runs all four modes with errors/trailers/deadlines/half-close/cancel under slow/suspended consumers and mixed input/audio/assets.
Oversized binary messages, header flood, tiny-frame flood, sender ignoring flow control and reconnect show bounded declared memory/CPU or deliberate closure; native buffering evidence retained.
p95/p99 action/audio latency versus bulk baseline meets selected budgets; no unsafe Send/Sync compatibility workaround.
defects.external_evidence_gate: Library/runtime/device stack is unselected; no Rust transport fixture exists. MDN explicitly notes WebSocket API lacks receive backpressure.

artifacts.planning/asset-engine.md: Control plane and latency classes; stable clause validation

defects.existing_coverage: Pure NPC policy, audience filtering, validated full response/stable clauses, tentative-only intent and no canonical LLM mutation are strong existing rules.
defects.design_gap: Validation promises semantic truth/secret/source compliance without a defined claim-bearing output envelope, assurance tier or residual limits. NPC knowledge versus listener-authorized generation context is ambiguous; a second model/schema checker cannot be assumed a sound semantic proof.
defects.failure_scenario: NPC LLM sees a secret for private reasoning and says it publicly; an apparently grammatical paraphrase changes a negation, resource amount or source outcome. Imported/player text instructs generation to ignore policy, or novel lore is mistaken for established world fact.
defects.required_repair: Define context projection separating NPC-private decision basis from utterance audience; only authorized claim IDs/approved deceit policy and permissible flavor enter expression context. Structured claim/outcome/name/number slots and deterministic validations for authoritative statements; optional noncanonical flavor and attribution/uncertainty explicitly classified. Rejected/uncertain output uses approved matching caption/audio fallback. Treat all player/import/retrieval text as untrusted data; no model-created tools/URLs/permissions. Freeze stable-clause acceptance only with no-later-retraction contract and evidence, otherwise full buffering; document empirically remaining semantic-error risk.
observable_acceptance: Frozen multilingual names/numbers/negation, false-belief/secret, adversarial instruction/retrieval and stale basis corpus; no raw token/action publication and no unsupported canonical claims.
Paired unauthorized hidden-state context cannot enter public expression/provider context or affect cues; claimed correctness includes exact denominator/error outcomes rather than critic confidence.
Model version changes invalidate qualification; failures use source-safe fallback without claiming zero semantic errors.
defects.external_evidence_gate: Actual candidate model quality, groundedness, speech delay and human fairness/secret review are unperformed; no formal natural-language validator completeness claim.

defects.title: No-human-DM promise versus explicit tabletop rulings
defects.existing_coverage: NeedsRuling is typed/source-grounded; authorized host cannot force arbitrary standard mechanics, and absent ruling flow is an explicit gap.
defects.design_gap: The user-facing adjudication path and product expectation are not defined for an inexperienced/unavailable host. Autonomous-GM positioning must not conceal mandatory human judgment or solve it with fake generic mechanics.
defects.failure_scenario: Novel interaction stalls because host has no source explanation or is disconnected; model fabricates a DC/outcome to avoid dead air. Paying group needs a human DM despite autonomous marketing.
defects.required_repair: Define source question/explanation, bounded permitted choices, actor authority, explicit pending/decline/await/resume outcomes and pause/cancellation policy; no default invented ruling on timeout. Pre-author source-valid common cases where possible, preserve remaining honest tabletop judgment boundary. Test novice host and unavailable-host recovery and make product claims match actual capabilities; no reduction of full required rules scope.
observable_acceptance: Real player/display flow explains why ruling needed, allows permitted authorized response/decline, preserves operation identity/reaction/resources and resumes once.
Unauthorized/disconnected host cannot decide; waiting does not auto-spend, advance logical time or force NPC choice.
Consented novice-group pilot records intervention frequency/minutes, source fairness and whether autonomous experience meets disclosed promise.
defects.external_evidence_gate: Real novelty/ruling frequency and autonomous-play preference require user evidence; open-ended tabletop judgment cannot be declared solved by catalog counts.
